collection_caveats: Coverage is relative to the currently published source lists; 2026 proceedings may still change.
TCC 2026 includes 69 papers from the official accepted-paper list before DBLP has indexed those proceedings.
CryptoDB was inaccessible during this expansion; publisher metadata and abstracts supplemented conference rosters, with OpenAlex enrichment where available.
Missing abstracts are recorded explicitly. A listed paper is not evidence that its abstract has been obtained.
The embedding archive is unchanged and covers the original 12,425 papers. The 3,343 new papers require an embedding build before local similarity search can rank them.
